chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadhl narrated from Muhammad ibn Ali, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Zurarah, who said:
I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: 'The father is the only one who annuls the marriage.'

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: Abu Ja'far (Imam al-Sadiq, peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: Who has the exclusive right to annul a minor girl's marriage in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the exclusive right of the father (*al-Ab*) to annul the marriage of his minor daughter, a key point of discussion in Shia jurisprudence regarding the hierarchy of marriage guardians (*awliya*). While the grandfather holds a secondary position, this narration emphasizes the father's primary authority in dissolving the contract, distinguishing his role from other male relatives. This ruling is foundational in understanding the practical application of *kafa'a* and the legal capacity of guardians in Shia family law.
